name: Battery replacement
summary: We test the old pack, fit a quality cell and calibrate it so the percentage tells the truth.

name: Upgrades & data recovery
summary: Faster SSDs and more RAM, with your files moved across. Failing drive? We recover what can be recovered.

name: Thermal clean & repaste
summary: Dust out, fan bearings checked, fresh thermal compound. Cooler, quieter, faster under load.

name: Chip-level board repair
summary: No power, no display, shorted rails. We repair the faulty component instead of replacing the whole board.

name: Keyboard, trackpad & liquid damage
summary: Sticky or dead keys, unresponsive trackpads and spills. Bring it in powered off, as soon as you can.

name: Screen & hinge replacement
summary: Cracked panels, flicker, dead backlights and loose hinges, matched to your exact model.
